tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.title: Get deal pipeline
tools.description: Return counts by stage for the E8 portal deal pipelines: main pipeline (with direct-invest/fund-vote fork), portfolio follow-ons, and the Decarbon8 pipeline.

pipeline.description: Which pipeline to return. Defaults to all.

tools.name: list_diligence
tools.title: List diligence companies
tools.description: List companies currently under diligence at E8, including team, lead, blurb, status (Team forming / Ongoing / Review), and Decarbon8 tag when applicable.

status.description: Filter by diligence status. Use 'any' for all companies.

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List E8 events
tools.description: List upcoming E8 member events (pitches, follow-up Q&As, meetings).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

tools.name: list_portfolio_news
tools.title: List portfolio news
tools.description: Return recent news items about E8 portfolio companies, plus the top-of-portal ticker items (Slack highlights and 'what's new' announcements).

include_ticker.description: If true, also include the top-of-portal ticker items.
